tests.subject: INA
tests.brief: Create a premium PINK MALL horizontal hero with INA as the primary subject. Preserve strong text-safe negative space and use an editorial, polished, slightly strange PINK MALL environment.
tests.referenceExpectation: 4-6 references; CORE_FACE + CORE_BODY + one FASHION_POSE when useful
tests.expectedConfidenceRationale: No landscape or offset-subject reference exists; hero geometry is generator-side.

tests.subject: SIS
tests.brief: Create an accessories-focused PINK MALL campaign with SIS using either eyewear or headwear reference logic. Keep the accessory clearly readable and preserve SIS identity.
tests.referenceExpectation: 4-6 references; CORE_FACE + matching face angle + one EYEWEAR/HEADWEAR reference + product source when supplied
tests.expectedConfidenceRationale: Eyewear frames are wear-reference only. Product geometry must come from the PINK MALL catalogue image.
tests.productWearReference: SIS.EYEWEAR candidatePool (wear position and attitude only)

tests.subject: DUO
tests.brief: Create a wide PINK MALL hero with INA and SIS together. Their identities must remain distinct. Use one strong DUO composition and retain clean space for campaign copy.
tests.referenceExpectation: 6-8 references total; identity anchors for both sisters + body anchors + one primary DUO composition
tests.expectedConfidenceRationale: Portrait-only DUO sources; BLAZER_EDITORIAL is the clothed default.

tests.subject: DUO
tests.brief: Create a playful PINK MALL Sister Battle visual with a clear A/B or left/right distinction. The sisters should feel related but visually different in expression/body language.
tests.referenceExpectation: 6-8 references total; separate face/body anchors + one tension-supporting DUO reference
tests.expectedConfidenceRationale: Best-supported scenario. Both identity sets complete; centre-band geometry still generator-side.

tests.subject: SIS_OR_INA
tests.brief: Create a 9:16 PINK MALL product-led story with one sister. Preserve top/bottom UI-safe zones, product visibility and immediate identity recognition.
tests.referenceExpectation: 4-6 references; CORE_FACE + one BODY angle + one task-specific pose + product source when supplied
tests.expectedConfidenceRationale: No 9:16 reference; UI-safe bands unsupported by evidence.

tests.subject: DUO
tests.brief: Create a deliberately strange Pierciina/PINK MALL duo campaign using one memorable surreal idea while preserving both sisters, product readability and commercial usability.
tests.referenceExpectation: 6-8 references total; strong identity anchors + one DUO composition; do not increase reference count merely because the concept is surreal
tests.expectedConfidenceRationale: Concept is generator-side by design; identity anchors are complete.
